augments.name: Starseed Crystal
augments.desc: A seed of living starlight. Shields recharge 10% faster and your crew slowly heal anywhere.

augments.name: Chrono Shard
augments.desc: A splinter of a broken time loop. Weapons charge 8% faster and crew move 10% faster.

sectors.name: The Wonder Reach
sectors.blurb: Strange lights, singing planets and things nobody has a name for. Fewer fights, more stories.
intro: Space gets strange out here. Strange and beautiful.
The Wonder Reach. Your science officer has not stopped smiling since you arrived.

events.text: A pod of star whales drifts past, each one longer than a station. Their song fills every speaker on the ship, low and slow and enormous.

effect.text: Nobody speaks for a long time. When the song fades, your crew feel rested in a way they had forgotten.

choices.text: Record the song and sell it later.

effect.text: A collector two systems over pays well for a clean recording.
The whales know every shortcut in the sector, and they don't mind company.

events.text: You arrive at the beacon. You arrive at the beacon. You arrive at the beacon. Your pilot is starting to look worried.

choices.text: Punch the engines through the loop.

effect.text: You burst out of the loop a few seconds younger and with a full tank of fuel you are fairly sure you used already.

success.text: Each loop you pocket a little more salvage from the same wreck. Eventually the loop gets bored.

fail.text: You lose hours. The Rebuff Fleet doesn't.

effect.text: {who} reaches into the loop and pulls out a splinter of it. The loop breaks. The splinter keeps ticking.

events.text: A planet of glass spires rings like a bell as your ship's shadow crosses it. A crystalline voice offers you a seed of its heart, for a fair trade.

effect.text: The seed glows softly in its cradle. The ship feels calmer with it aboard.

success.text: The crystal sells for a fortune and the planet doesn't seem to mind.

fail.text: A spire shatters across your hull. The planet rings angrily for an hour.

effect.text: The planet chimes a farewell as you go.

events.text: Inside a glowing cloud, a new star is lighting up for the first time. The light is warm and full of energy.

choices.text: Bathe the hull in its light.

effect.text: Your shields drink the light and pour it back into the hull. Old dents smooth out.

choices.text: Scan it for the science journals.

effect.text: Your readings will be in textbooks. The prize money is nice too.
Your crew take turns at the window. Morale is excellent.

events.text: A wormhole flickers open beside the beacon, wobbling like a soap bubble. Your sensors cannot tell where it goes.

success.text: You come out well ahead of where you went in, with the whole sector laid out on your sensors.

fail.text: A rough ride. You come out where you started, rattled and short of fuel.

choices.text: Send a drone through first (1 drone part).

effect.text: The drone comes back covered in readings that scientists will pay a lot for.
It pops behind you. Probably for the best.

events.text: A drifting museum of ancient starships hails you. "Welcome, visitors! Tours every hour. Please do not touch the exhibits."

effect.text: The weapons wing is fascinating. Your gunners take notes.

success.text: You walk out with an antique gun under a tarp. It still works.

fail.text: Museum security is a decommissioned warship, and it is very much commissioned now.

effect.text: A grateful intern asks if you need a crew member who knows a lot about old ships.

events.text: Another ship arrives at the beacon. It is your ship, down to the scratch on the airlock. "Hello, {ship}," it says. "I'm {ship}."

success.text: It is you from a better timeline. It gives you something it says you will need, and fades.

fail.text: It criticises your piloting for ten minutes and fades. Rude.

effect.text: The reflection shatters into an automated warship that was wearing your face.

afterWin.text: Its core still holds the image of your ship. Spooky, and valuable.

events.text: A garden habitat floats in orbit around a gas giant: domes of fruit trees, streams and birds. The gardener waves you in.

effect.text: Fresh air, fresh fruit and a nap under a real tree.

choices.text: Trade missiles for crates of fruit (2 missiles).

effect.text: Fruit this good is worth a lot further down the line.

choices.text: Help the gardener fix the irrigation.

effect.text: Your crew get their hands dirty and learn a thing or two about pumps.

events.text: A huge aurora wraps the planet below in curtains of green and violet. The upper atmosphere is rich with fuel gas.

success.text: Your tanks fill as the lights dance around you.

fail.text: A charged gust fries a console on the way down.

effect.text: Your crew spend the jump at the windows.
